nodes.title: LTX Multishot Prompt + Refs

widgets_values:
## Multishot ShotPlan (LTX-2.3)

Adaptation of the `LTX Multishot Prompt + Refs` node created by Alisson Anjos (alisson-anjos), added to ComfyUI-BFSNodes on 2026-08-01, built on this repo's verified `Text to Video (LTX-2.3)` blueprint.

- nodes: https://github.com/alisson-anjos/ComfyUI-BFSNodes

## ⚠ The LoRA this needs is not published yet

The node targets `multishot_strata_r128_v1`, trained on the Pensioner/ShotPlan keyframe set. As of this commit that file is not on Hugging Face — the node shipped ahead of the weights — so **no profile can provision it** and this template will report a missing LoRA until it appears. When it does, drop it in as:

```
📂 ComfyUI/models/loras/bfs/multishot_strata_r128_v1.safetensors
```

Everything else here comes from the shared LTX-2.3 base, so selecting `bfs-ltx-2.3-multishot` gets you the rest of the stack today.

## How it works

One prompt for the whole clip in ShotPlan caption format — a global preamble, then `Shot 1:`, `Shot 2:` … — plus one reference keyframe per shot. The builder assembles both from the per-shot fields, so you never hand-write the format.

- **Batch order is shot order.** The LoRA was trained with `shuffle_reference_slots: false`, so slot N means shot N and nothing else.
- **Shots compact.** Fill keyframes 1 and 3 and leave 2 empty and you get Shot 1 / Shot 2 on slots 0 and 1. Slot 0 must always be the opening shot.
- **Unused slots are padded with flat mid-grey**, the blank the dataset used for samples with fewer than four shots.
- **Vocabularies are not decorative.** The shot-size and camera-move dropdowns are the terms that actually occur in the training captions; anything outside them is out of distribution.
- **Keep action lines short.** The text encoder truncates at 1024 tokens and four real ShotPlan shots already run long — overflow eats the last shot's description.

`LTX Identity Transfer` is set to `layout=strata`, `source_id=2`, `phase_scale=1.0`, which reproduces the trained convention: source_id 2/3/4/5 on strata slots 0/1/2/3. Changing the layout is not a quality trade-off — it is a coordinate convention the model never learned.

The blueprint's image-to-video guide stays bypassed: the keyframes are separate reference tokens, not an I2V start frame.
